name: fw-publish
description: Publish Platform 3.0 apps to Freshworks Marketplace via MCP tools (app-upload, submit/update). MCP server config is bundled at the plugin root .mcp.json.

interface.longDescription: Auth preflight, fdk validate/pack, app-upload, submit/update via MCP. Configure Developer Portal JWT. Pair with fw-app-dev for manifest and validation fixes.
